# Rosetta API Gap Analysis

This file is the running ledger of `vscode.*` surface that Rosetta has
**not yet** implemented. It is regenerated by hand whenever
`src/shims/vscode.ts` or `src/marketplace/compatibility.ts` changes;
keep them in lock-step.

The gallery filter (`src/marketplace/compatibility.ts`) drops any
extension whose `activationEvents` or `contributes.*` keys land in a
section marked **❌ blocked** below — the manifest cannot run today.
Extensions that exercise APIs in **⚠️ partial** sections are surfaced
in the browse pane but may behave incorrectly until the gap closes.

> Stage references (Stage 4 / Stage 5) point to the Logos workstation
> dev plan. Anything outside Rosetta's stated scope (Marketplace ToS
> enforcement, extension signing, LiveShare, Settings Sync) is listed
> as **out-of-scope** and will not be filled in here.

---

## 1. `vscode` top-level

| Symbol | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | ✅ | Returns `"1.106.0-rosetta"` |
| `Uri.file`, `Uri.parse` | ⚠️ partial | Returns `{ fsPath, scheme }` only; no `with()`, `toString()`, `path`, `query`, `fragment`, `authority`. Needed by ~60 % of extensions. |
| `EventEmitter` | ✅ | |
| `Disposable` | ✅ | Class form supported; `Disposable.from(...)` static missing. |
| `CancellationTokenSource` | ❌ blocked | Internal `makeCancellationToken` exists but is not exported on the namespace. |
| `Range`, `Position`, `Location`, `Selection` | ❌ blocked | **High priority**. Required by every language provider and document edit. |
| `TextEdit`, `WorkspaceEdit` | ❌ blocked | Required for refactoring/code-action providers. |
| `MarkdownString`, `Hover` | ❌ blocked | Hover providers cannot construct return values. |
| `CompletionItem`, `CompletionItemKind`, `CompletionList`, `SnippetString` | ❌ blocked | Completion providers can register but cannot build results. |
| `Diagnostic`, `DiagnosticSeverity`, `DiagnosticRelatedInformation`, `DiagnosticTag` | ❌ blocked | No diagnostics surface at all. |
| `CodeAction`, `CodeActionKind`, `CodeActionTriggerKind` | ❌ blocked | |
| `SymbolInformation`, `DocumentSymbol`, `SymbolKind`, `SymbolTag` | ❌ blocked | |
| `ThemeIcon`, `ThemeColor` | ❌ blocked | Tree views & status bar items cannot show theme icons. |
| `TreeItem`, `TreeItemCollapsibleState`, `TreeItemCheckboxState` | ❌ blocked | The shim accepts a `TreeDataProvider` but the value classes are missing. |
| `RelativePattern` | ❌ blocked | `findFiles` accepts the string form only. |
| `FileType`, `FileSystemError`, `FilePermission` | ❌ blocked | |
| `EndOfLine`, `TextEditorRevealType`, `TextEditorCursorStyle`, `TextEditorLineNumbersStyle`, `TextEditorSelectionChangeKind` | ❌ blocked | |
| `ConfigurationTarget` | ⚠️ partial | Numeric constant accepted in `update()` but not exported. |
| `ExtensionMode`, `ExtensionKind` | ❌ blocked | |
| `LogLevel` | ❌ blocked | Required for `LogOutputChannel`. |
| `Color`, `ColorInformation`, `ColorPresentation` | ❌ blocked | |
| `SemanticTokens`, `SemanticTokensBuilder`, `SemanticTokensLegend` | ❌ blocked | |
| `InlayHint`, `InlayHintKind`, `InlayHintLabelPart` | ❌ blocked | |
| `InlineCompletionItem`, `InlineCompletionList` | ❌ blocked | Copilot-style providers. |

## 7. Namespaces with **no** shim today

These return `undefined` if accessed and will throw on any property
access. They are out of bounds for the current marketplace filter (any
manifest using them is rejected via `activationEvents` /
`contributes.*` heuristics):

| Namespace | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| `vscode.env` | **High priority**. Need at least `appName`, `appRoot`, `language`, `machineId`, `sessionId`, `uriScheme`, `clipboard.readText`/`.writeText`, `openExternal`. Tiny surface, big compat win. |
| `vscode.tasks` | Stage 4. |
| `vscode.scm` | Stage 4 (Logos has its own VCS plumbing — wire to it). |
| `vscode.tests` | Stage 4. |
| `vscode.notebooks` | Stage 5 — Logos's notebook story is unrelated to VS Code's. |
| `vscode.authentication` | Stage 5; ties into Logos's identity service. |
| `vscode.l10n` | Low priority; passthrough to `i18next` would suffice. |
| `vscode.lm` (Language Model) | Out-of-scope — model routing is a Logos primitive. |
| `vscode.chat`, `vscode.chatVariables` | Out-of-scope. |
| `vscode.comments` | Stage 5. |
| `vscode.interactive` | Out-of-scope. |
| `vscode.aiSuggestions` | Out-of-scope. |

---

## 8. Priority queue

If we close gaps in this order, marketplace coverage — measured as the
fraction of OpenVSX's top-100 that pass `evaluateCompatibility` — is
projected to jump in chunks of ~20 % per row:

1. **Value classes** — `Range`, `Position`, `Location`, `Selection`,
   `TextEdit`, `WorkspaceEdit`, `MarkdownString`, `Hover`,
   `CompletionItem`, `CompletionItemKind`, `Diagnostic`,
   `DiagnosticSeverity`, `ThemeIcon`, `TreeItem`,
   `TreeItemCollapsibleState`, `RelativePattern`, `FileType`,
   `EndOfLine`. *(pure data, no host plumbing)*
2. **`vscode.env`** — small constant surface, unblocks env-aware code.
3. **`workspace.workspaceFolders` + change events** — every project-aware
   extension reads these.
4. **`window.activeTextEditor` + `showTextDocument` + selection events**
   — unblocks LSP-bridge style extensions.
5. **`languages.createDiagnosticCollection` + diagnostics events** —
   unblocks every linter.
6. **Remaining `languages.register*Provider` calls** — share the
   provider-callback machinery already in `src/shims/vscode.ts`.
7. **`workspace.createFileSystemWatcher` + file events** — unblocks
   build/watch extensions.
8. **`window.createTerminal` + `tabGroups`** — Stage 4.
9. **`debug.*` event surface + `registerDebugAdapterDescriptorFactory`**.
10. **`scm`, `tasks`, `tests`** — Stage 4.

---

## How to update this document

When you add a method to `src/shims/vscode.ts`:

1. Add the dotted path to `SUPPORTED_API_PATHS` in
   `src/marketplace/compatibility.ts`.
2. If the method backs a `contributes.*` key or an `activationEvents`
   prefix, add it to the matching set in the same file.
3. Move the row from a ❌ section above into ✅ / ⚠️ partial.
4. Re-run `npm run type-check` and the marketplace integration test
   (once it lands) to confirm the gallery filter relaxes.
